title_template: {work_unit_id} — Validate Human-by-Exception durable multi-session steady state under existing authority only
goal: Validate repeated Human-by-Exception durable session resumes across multiple control-plane sessions using fresh Provider Truth, unique completed-transaction fingerprints and only already-canonical delegated authority.
scope: validate at least two durable Human-by-Exception session handoffs with fresh Provider Truth, canonical main, selected work-unit and bounded-branch readback at every resumed session
discard persisted control-loop, execution-admission, CI-success and registry-CAS decisions before every resumed session
preserve completed transaction fingerprints across handoffs and reject any replay in a later session
treat expired historical ACTIVE and RELEASED Writer Leases as observations only and never reuse, reactivate, silently steal or retrospectively release them
require a fresh monotonic Writer Lease claim through already-canonical reusable Writer Lease authority when a resumed session has no exact owned ACTIVE unexpired lease
allow at most one delegated control-plane transaction per fresh iteration and require exact provider or branch readback before another iteration
preserve OWNER_ESCALATION_REQUIRED, WAIT_ONLY, STOP_ONLY, SEPARATE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED and BLOCKED as distinct no-mutation or fail-closed outcomes
forbidden_scope: create, infer or broaden provider-state, issue, branch, pull-request, merge, runtime, product, release, ruleset, ADWF or higher-autonomy authority
reuse persisted control-loop, execution-admission, CI-success, merge-eligibility or registry-CAS decisions across session boundaries
replay a completed delegated transaction fingerprint in any later session
rewrite, reactivate, silently steal or retrospectively release expired historical Writer Lease records without separate exact authority
mutate product/runtime source or physical runtime
mutate ADWF binding/repository, release/tag/promotion, ruleset/security policy, PRIVATE evidence or 1080/1081 lifecycle
exit_criteria: multiple resumed sessions independently recompute fresh Provider Truth and never reuse persisted admission or CAS decisions
completed transaction fingerprints remain unique across sessions and replay is fail-closed
each delegated iteration has exactly one already-authorized control-plane transaction followed by fresh readback
expired historical ACTIVE and RELEASED Writer Leases remain observation-only
fresh monotonic Writer Lease claim semantics remain delegated only to existing reusable Writer Lease authority
OWNER_ESCALATION_REQUIRED, WAIT_ONLY, STOP_ONLY, SEPARATE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED and BLOCKED remain no-mutation or fail-closed outcomes
no new mutation or higher-autonomy authority is created
exact-head hosted CI passes with no product/runtime, ADWF, release/ruleset, PRIVATE evidence or 1080/1081 mutation
